title: Domain-reviewer, adopter & compute-path outreach
context: The project has three unsecured human/decision dependencies that gate later milestones: (1) a computational-pathology domain reviewer (hard gate for M2, deadline 2026-08-31); (2) at least 3 candidate adopters + 1 compute path in active conversation (target 2026-09-30); (3) a named adopter/steward for the benchmark (gates M4, deadline 2026-12-31). Without a domain reviewer, no benchmark task, split, or result may be published. Without an adopter/steward, the project cannot reach Definition of Shipped. This outreach task initiates the dated acquisition plan. See PLAN.md (Partner/compute-path outreach, Risks).
objective: Draft and log an outreach plan targeting: (a) a qualified computational-pathology/bioinformatics domain reviewer (candidates: academic comp-path labs, WSI toolkit maintainers such as OpenSlide/CLAM/TIAToolbox, challenge organizers); (b) at least 3 candidate adopters (research labs, MICCAI/Grand-Challenge organizers, teaching programs); (c) a compute-path option (donated or funded GPU). Produce a logged status document recording: candidates contacted, responses, next steps, and dates — with the build-vs-mothball decision rule (if no adopter by ~2027-03-31, pivot or mothball) noted.
acceptanceCriteria: A named list of at least 3 candidate domain-reviewer contacts (labs, toolkit maintainers, or challenge organizers) is documented with outreach status.
A named list of at least 3 candidate adopters (research labs, challenge/toolkit groups, teaching programs) is documented with outreach status.
At least 1 candidate compute-path option (donated or funded GPU) is identified and its status logged.
Acquisition deadlines are recorded: domain reviewer by 2026-08-31; adopters/compute in conversation by 2026-09-30; adopter/steward secured by 2026-12-31.
The build-vs-mothball/pivot decision rule (~2027-03-31 if no adopter secured) is noted in the document.
The document is committed as a governance log entry (e.g. docs/governance/outreach-log.md) via PR.
output: An outreach status log (committed via PR) recording candidate domain-reviewer, adopter, and compute-path contacts with their outreach status, acquisition deadlines, and the build-vs-mothball decision rule.
